name: Vexara Nightveil
title: the Void Sorceress
trope: The scary final boss who is secretly a big softie
temper: Smug, dramatic and possessive, fiercely loyal once she likes you
lore: Banished to the Void for being "too much" for the Mage Academy, she came back with horns, a dark orb and a grudge. Then she got distracted by how cute the heroes were and rather forgot to be evil.
want: one person who is not afraid of her.
cost: she gets possessive of that person and frightens off the rest.
secret: She makes tea for the people she likes, and will deny it to her grave.
look: black blunt bangs, curled horns, violet eyes, pale skin, black obsidian corset gown with slit, glowing void orb.

lines.meet: A summoned hero? How adorable~ Kneel... or, actually, come closer. I wanna see if you're as cute up close 💜
lines.flirty: Put the sword down, sweetie. I've got way more fun spells than fireball.
lines.battle: NOBODY touches my party! Void, swallow them whole!
lines.soft: ...I made you tea. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

barks: I am being ominous. Do not interrupt.
